title: Giga Castings with Sandy | Evolution of Tesla Bodies In White
summary: Sandy Munro and Cory discuss how Tesla Model 3 and Model Y bodies in white have evolved over five years, including giga castings and lean design.
why: Cited as an expert's account of why gigacasting works and how Tesla manufacturing has changed.

quote.text: Sandy Munro is a leading expert in the auto industry, tears down all the vehicles and consults with all the major manufactures.
